About the Team
OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.
Role Overview
We are seeking an experienced ASIC Package Signal Integrity / Power Integrity Engineer to drive electrical architecture, modeling, optimization, and validation for the most advanced AI/HPC silicon and package design.
This role focuses on high-speed SerDes and memory channel architecture, advanced 2.5D/3D package SI/PI, substrate to package co-design, power-delivery-network optimization, electromagnetic modeling, and simulation-to-measurement correlation.
The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with high-speed channel and PDN analysis across ASIC packages, interposers, substrates, and power-delivery structures, and can translate simulation results into practical design requirements for interposers and package substrate design optimization.
The engineer will work closely with ASIC, package, system, mechanical, thermal, power, and silicon validation teams from early architecture and feasibility studies through production bring-up.
In this role you will
• Own SI/PI architecture and analysis for advanced AI ASIC packages from early feasibility studies through production.

• Develop and optimize high-speed electrical channels for 200G/400G SerDes, PCIe, HBM, DDR, and chiplet/die-to-die interfaces.

• Perform package, interposer and substrate modeling using 2D/3D electromagnetic solvers.

• Define and optimize package stack-ups, transmission-line structures, via transitions, breakout structures, return paths, ground shielding, bump maps, and ball maps based on SI/PI requirements.

• Develop channel loss, crosstalk, impedance, skew, return-loss, and link-budget requirements, and translate them into actionable package layout guidelines.

• Perform package-level PDN analysis, including impedance, loop inductance, DCIR, EM, dynamic voltage droop, current distribution, decoupling optimization, and power/ground architecture.

• Drive die/package co-design, including bump/BGA assignment, stack-up optimization, power/ground allocation, high-speed I/O placement, and package routing architecture.

• Develop simulation methodologies and automation flows for early architecture exploration, design-space optimization, and repeatable SI/PI sign-off.

Required Qualifications
• 5+ years of experience in signal integrity, power integrity, high-speed interconnect design, PDN design and package electrical design.

• Strong understanding of signal-integrity and power-integrity fundamentals, including transmission-line behavior, impedance, loss, crosstalk, return paths, power-distribution networks, inductance, decoupling, voltage droop, and current distribution.

• Hands-on experience with electromagnetic and SI/PI simulation tools such as Synopsys HSPICE, Ansys EDT, HFSS-PI, SIwave, Cadence Clarity, Sigrity PowerSI/PowerDC, or equivalent.

• Experience with package layout environments such as Cadence APD/SIP, including the ability to review and modify package structures for SI/PI optimization.

• Experience developing automated design optimization flows for model extraction, simulation setup, post-processing, design-space exploration, or layout optimization.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across ASIC, package, PCB, system, mechanical, thermal, power, validation, and manufacturing teams.

Preferred Qualifications
• Hands-on experience with advanced 2.5D/3D packaging, silicon or organic interposers, bridge technologies, HBM integration, IVR integration, or large-body AI/HPC packages.

• Experience developing early-stage SI/PI feasibility methodologies that support chip and package architecture decisions.

• Experience with memory architecture and high-speed memory interfaces, including HBM and DDR/LPDDR.

• Experience with high-speed laboratory validation using VNA, spectrum analyzers, TDR/TDT, high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, and probe-based measurements.

• Knowledge of package and PCB material properties, including dielectric constant, loss tangent, copper roughness, and manufacturing variation.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

The Reddit Consumer Engineering organization builds and scales the products that Redditors use directly to discover content, participate in communities, and connect with others. Sitting at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems and core user journeys, Product Engineers in Consumer Engineering partner directly with Product Managers, Designers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and Frontend Engineers to build, experiment with, and scale features that power how hundreds of millions of users discover, join, navigate, and engage with Reddit.

This centralized role hires across several high-impact consumer teams, including:

  • Core Product & Feeds: Home Experience, Recommendations & Content Discovery, Content Contribution
  • Community & Presence: Reddit Pro, Youth Experience & Teen Safety, Creator Tools
  • Growth & Engagement: Authentication, Notifications, Social Sharing, SEO, Onboarding.
  • Monetization & Conversion: Paid User Acquisition, Conversion Funnel Optimization
  • Identity & Security: Account Management, Trust & Safety

What You’ll Do

  • Cross-Functional Product Architecture: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Design, Data Science, and Client Engineers (iOS/Android/Web) to translate business and user needs into reliable, low-latency technical solutions.
  • End-to-End Delivery: Own the full software lifecycle for major product initiatives from technical design docs and API contracts to development, testing, rollout, and observability.
  • Metrics & Experimentation-Led Engineering: Design, build, and evaluate A/B experiments. Work with tools like BigQuery, HEX, or Firebase to analyze user behavior, conversion funnels, and retention loops to make data-backed engineering decisions.
  • API & System Performance: Build and maintain scalable APIs (GraphQL, REST, gRPC) and distributed backend services optimized for client consumption and consumer UI performance.
  • Technical Rigor & Modern Tooling: Establish engineering best practices, improve developer workflows, mentor teammates, and use modern, AI-integrated tools to ship high-quality products efficiently.

Who You Are

  • User-Centric Mindset: An advocate for the user with an intuitive feel for product usability, interaction design, social dynamics, and user growth loops. You care deeply about why a feature is being built and its impact on the end user.

  • Collaborative Communicator: Outstanding communication skills with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment in fully remote or hybrid team environments.

  • Experience with one or more front-end web frameworks such as LIT, Polymer, React, Vue, or Angular with experience with CSS.

OpenAI’s 1P Hardware Systems team operates at the intersection of Hardware Engineering, Infrastructure, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Deployment, and Finance to translate infrastructure demand into an executable systems plan.
The Planning Lead connects system demand and deployment timing to site and configuration requirements, power availability, XPU needs, hardware supply commitments, manufacturing capacity, and site readiness.

About the Role
OpenAI is seeking a 1P Hardware Systems Planning Lead to own the integrated demand, supply, and deployment plan for our 1P AI infrastructure systems. This role will connect infrastructure demand and site power availability to system configurations, XPU requirements, and hardware supply commitments—creating a single, actionable view of whether our deployment plan can be met.
You will establish the planning mechanisms that allow teams to see what changed, understand the impact, and act quickly when demand, supply, configuration, site readiness, or power timing moves. You will work across Hardware Engineering, Infrastructure, Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing, Manufacturing, Deployment, and Finance to identify gaps early and drive recovery plans to closure.
This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who combines systems-level thinking, strong analytical judgment, and rigorous program execution. The ideal candidate can turn complex and changing inputs into a clear operating plan, surface the decisions that matter, and drive accountability across teams without relying on formal authority. Success also requires strong communication judgment: the ability to align cross-functional teams, brief leadership at a concise and decision-oriented level, and go deep into the underlying assumptions, dependencies, risks, and recovery plans when needed.

Responsibilities
• Integrated Planning - Own the integrated planning process for 1P hardware systems, connecting system demand, deployment timing, site and configuration requirements, power availability, XPU needs, and supply commitments.

• Maintain a clear, decision-ready supply plan that shows changes from the prior plan; weekly pull-ins and push-outs; site, deployment, and system-configuration impacts; power availability assumptions and timing; system demand and corresponding XPU requirements; current supplier and manufacturing commitments; gaps between forecast, requirements, and committed supply; and recovery actions with accountable owners and target closure dates.

• Validate that the end-to-end supply plan is executable, including the timing and dependencies across components, XPU availability, system integration, factory capacity, site readiness, and deployment.

• Operating Cadence & Change Management - Lead a weekly deployment and supply review focused on material changes, emerging risks, required decisions, and recovery-plan execution.

• Publish and maintain a weekly delta report that clearly explains what changed, why it changed, and the downstream impact to deployments, sites, configurations, power, and supply.

• Track forecast-versus-commit gaps at a weekly level, identify the underlying constraints, and drive recovery plans with named owners and dates.

• Coordinate the biweekly end-to-end supply picture update for leadership and key stakeholders, including the latest system forecast; how the forecast aligns with site power availability and timing; current supply commitments; weekly gaps to commit; and the plan and timing to close each gap.

• Cross-Functional Execution & Risk Management - Partner with Hardware Engineering and Infrastructure teams to translate roadmap, configuration, and deployment changes into updated system and XPU requirements.

• Work through the Supply Chain team to pressure-test commitments with manufacturing partners and suppliers, understand constraints, and establish credible recovery paths.

• Anticipate supply and deployment risks, develop scenarios and tradeoffs, and provide crisp recommendations to senior leaders.

• Process & Operational Scaling - Build scalable planning models, reporting standards, and operating mechanisms that improve forecast accuracy, change control, traceability, and executive decision-making as 1P infrastructure scales.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications
• Significant experience in hardware systems planning, supply planning, program management, operations, or a related role supporting complex, high-volume technology products or infrastructure.

• Strong understanding of the dependencies among hardware demand, component supply, manufacturing capacity, system configurations, site readiness, power availability, and deployment schedules.

• Experience building and managing integrated demand-and-supply plans at weekly granularity, including forecast changes, supply commits, gaps, scenarios, and recovery actions.

• Demonstrated ability to pressure-test whether a plan is executable rather than simply consolidating inputs from different teams.

• Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to translate complex datasets and technical dependencies into clear insights, decisions, and actions.

• Strong program leadership, including experience establishing operating cadences, driving cross-functional accountability, and closing issues across organizations.

• Demonstrated experience communicating effectively across cross-functional teams and with senior leadership, with the judgment to tailor the level of detail to the audience—distilling complex issues into concise, decision-ready updates while going deep on assumptions, dependencies, risks, and recovery plans when needed.

• Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-ambiguity environment where requirements, priorities, and constraints evolve quickly.

• High ownership, sound judgment, and a bias toward surfacing risks early and driving them through resolution.

Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with AI infrastructure, hyperscale data centers, or accelerator systems.

• Experience with semiconductors, server or rack manufacturing, or complex hardware supply chains.

What Success Looks Like
• A single, trusted view of 1P hardware system demand, supply commitments, deployment timing, and associated gaps.

• Clear weekly visibility into changes, pull-ins, push-outs, and their impact on sites, configurations, power, systems, and XPUs.

• Early identification of risks to the deployment plan, with quantified impact and actionable recovery paths.

• Work through SCPM and strategic sourcing to ensure every material gap has a clear recovery plan, accountable owner, target date, and escalation path.

• Forecast, supply, manufacturing, site-readiness, and power assumptions remain aligned across teams.

• Leadership receives a concise, consistent, and decision-oriented biweekly view of the end-to-end supply picture.

• Planning processes and tools scale with the pace, volume, and complexity of OpenAI’s 1P infrastructure roadmap.
